outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter/dot plots with mean±SD bars, and individual mouse data points (n=5 per group) are clearly overlaid.
Panel B shows representative gross photographic images of mice, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows representative H&E and Oil Red O micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D shows dot blot and methylene blue staining images, not a quantitative plot requiring individual data points.
The 5mC/Methylene Blue quantification is shown as a bar chart with mean±SD, and individual data points (n=5 per group) are overlaid as dots.
The western blot images are accompanied by a bar chart of TET1/TET2/TET3 over GAPDH ratios with mean±SD, and individual data points for each animal (n=6 NC, n=7 HFD) are overlaid as dots/squares.
